about.title: About World Clock - Global Time Display
about.description: The World Clock displays current time across multiple time zones simultaneously, making it perfect for tracking time in different cities around the world. Essential for international business, travel planning, and staying connected with global contacts. Features real-time updates with automatic daylight saving time adjustments, customizable city selection, and clean visual display for easy time comparison across regions.

faq.q: How often does the world clock update?
faq.a: The world clock updates in real-time, typically every second, ensuring you always see the current accurate time for all displayed locations. The updates are synchronized with atomic time servers for maximum precision.

faq.q: Can I add custom time zones and cities?
faq.a: Yes, you can search for and add any city or time zone from our comprehensive database of world locations. The database includes major cities, capitals, and important business centers from every time zone globally.

faq.q: Does it automatically handle daylight saving time?
faq.a: Yes, the clock automatically adjusts for daylight saving time changes in all supported locations throughout the year. It accounts for different DST schedules across countries and regions, ensuring accuracy during transitions.

faq.q: How many cities can I display simultaneously?
faq.a: You can display multiple cities simultaneously, with the interface optimized for easy comparison of times across different zones. The layout adapts to show your selected cities clearly without cluttering the display.
